map_pois.name: Barrow Stair
map_pois.blurb: Up to the Standing Stones in the Whisperwood.

map_pois.name: Hall of Shades
map_pois.blurb: Burial niches; the dead here do not rest.

map_pois.name: Ossuary
map_pois.blurb: Bones stacked to the ceiling, and something under them.

map_pois.name: Barrow Hall
map_pois.blurb: The crypt's crossing; a waypoint stone still glows.

map_pois.name: The Paladin's Tomb
map_pois.blurb: A Concord paladin lies here in armour no rust has touched.

map_pois.name: Barrow-Lord's Vault
map_pois.blurb: The deepest vault. Its lord does not sleep.
